digest.component_or_area: review bot LLM token metrics emission
propositions: LLM review bot computes per-call token usage (_usage dict with input/output/cache tokens) but discards it instead of emitting to CloudWatch for billing visibility
_attach_code_review_metrics must aggregate input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens across all _usage-bearing succeeded steps and add totals to coverage.metrics

_publish_token_usage_metrics must emit five named CloudWatch metrics (review_bot_llm_*_tokens) to Namespace rebar/host with Unit Count via best-effort boto3, swallowing import/credential failures without raising
review_and_vote must invoke token publisher with verdict coverage.metrics after successful vote, with token emission never failing the vote itself
Pass-1 finder token usage is excluded from this ticket (larger riskier change deferred to follow-up), covering only Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide agent-step usage
